backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for Roaf Agro Traders backend, managing user profiles, a static business profile, product catalog (CRUD with filtering), and order management with role-based access control via included authorization and blob-storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (rental section, home delivery badge, Srachi dealer highlight, product rental badge) to their corresponding frontend files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary providing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a quick reference for what each page and component does after recent feature additions.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark themes, including sidebar, chart, and semantic UI colors.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, setting the page title to 'Roaf Agro Traders' and mounting the app via the `/src/main.tsx` module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application file that defines the TanStack Router route tree, wraps the app in ThemeProvider and Toaster, implements an AdminGuard component for protected routes, and renders the shared Layout with Header and Footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Site footer with a 4-column grid covering brand info, quick navigation links, a services column highlighting home delivery, machine rental, and Srachi dealer status, and contact details.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Responsive site header with logo, navigation links, admin dropdown, and Internet Identity login/logout controls, including a mobile sheet menu.
frontend/src/components/product/ProductC: Displays a single product as a card with category image, availability badge, rental badge, price, and optional action buttons.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users to enter their name to complete profile setup, blocking interaction until saved via the provided `onSave` callback.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, managing AuthClient creation, login, logout, and identity persistence with status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for backend interactions, covering business profile, user profile, admin check, product catalog, inventory, and sales order CRUD operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing fonts and defining Tailwind CSS custom design tokens (colors, radius, sidebar) for both light and dark themes using CSS variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/admin/CreateOrderPage: Admin page for creating a new customer order by selecting products into a cart, setting quantities, and submitting via `useCreateOrder`, then navigating to the orders list.
frontend/src/pages/admin/InventoryManage: Admin page for managing inventory items with add, edit, and delete operations via dialogs, displaying stock levels in a table and highlighting low-stock items.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderDetailsPag: Admin page that displays full details of a single order (customer info, items, timestamps) fetched by ID, and allows updating the order status via a dropdown with toast feedback.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin page listing all orders in a filterable table with status counts, inline status update controls, and a link to create new orders.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ProductManageme: Admin page for managing the product catalog, supporting add, edit, and delete operations via dialogs and confirmation alerts using React Query mutations.
frontend/src/pages/BusinessProfilePage.t: Displays the Roaf Agro Traders business profile page with a hero section, authorized dealer badges, and dynamic profile data fetched via `useGetBusinessProfile`, showing skeletons while loading.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the public-facing home page with a hero section, featured products, and product category grid, pulling data from `useGetBusinessProfile` and `useGetProductCatalog`.
frontend/src/pages/ProductCatalogPage.ts: Shows a filterable, searchable product catalog page using `useGetProductCatalog`, supporting filters by category, availability, and text search with a clear-filters option.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing helper functions to read, persist, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based semantic color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and animation keyframes, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file describing the Roaf Agro Traders business website, tracking existing implemented features and pending new feature requests around rentals, home delivery, and Srachi dealership highlights.
